data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement was caused by a tool failure in the Qwen model, which returned HTTP 400 errors when attempting to audit the PKGBUILD and .SRCINFO files, resulting in an inconclusive verdict. coverage_issues: Qwen model failed to review PKGBUILD and .SRCINFO due to API errors (HTTP 400 BadRequestError).
learnings: The audit tool should implement retry logic or fallback mechanisms for transient API errors (e.g., HTTP 400/500) instead of immediately marking files as inconclusive.

When an escalation is triggered by a tool error rather than a genuine security disagreement, the system should recognize the error and defer to the successful audits from other models covering the same files.
